module full_adder(
    input f_bit,
    input s_bit,
    input carry_in,
    output s,
    output carry_out
);

assign s = f_bit ^ s_bit ^ carry_in;
assign carry_out = (f_bit & s_bit) | (carry_in & (f_bit ^ s_bit));

endmodule
